experiment: Q1 mixed UAV type per sortie, three single objectives
solver: exact subset dynamic programming; deterministic; no random seed

objectives.E-opt: min E, then N, then cumulative T
objectives.N-opt: min N, then E, then cumulative T
objectives.T-opt: min cumulative T, then E, then N

scope: O01-service-O01; indivisible boxes; each sortie chooses A/B/C; safe payload, volume and available energy enforced; no fleet scheduling, shared-battery or deadline constraints
